name: Neha Khurana
department: School of Liberal Arts and Sciences
bio: Neha Khurana is currently an Associate Professor at the School of Liberal Arts and Design Studies at Vidyashilp University (Bangalore, India) and has previously taught at Gargi College (University of Delhi) for about 10 years. Trained in English literature and its various streams, she found her research interests at the intersection of literary studies and visual cultures.She has recently completed her PhD with a thesis titled “The Right to Dissent: An Analysis of Political Cartooning in India During the Emergency Years 1975-77” and continues to research in the field of visual arts and surveillance studies. She likes to paint and sometimes dreams of being an artist.
